If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering is applied. If you specify this parameter, future scheduled items are not generated

page.description_zh: 分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200

pageSize.description_en: The collaboration group ID, such as cg_101. If you specify this parameter, the data is returned by group dimension, and the caller must be a valid group member. If you do not specify this parameter, the data is returned by personal dimension, excluding group tasks
pageSize.description_zh: 协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时按群维度返回（调用者需为有效群成员），未传时为个人维度（排除群任务）

collaborationGroupId.description_en: Pre-filters by a single task. If you do not specify this parameter, the execution records of all visible tasks are returned
collaborationGroupId.description_zh: 按单个任务预筛选；不传时返回全部可见任务的执行记录
